# New Mandarin Canton II (富源)

> A family-run Mandarin, Szechuan and Cantonese restaurant at 543 Telegraph
> Canyon Rd, Chula Vista, CA 91910, open seven days from 11:00 AM. Takeout
> pickup only — no delivery, and not on any delivery app. Order on the website
> or by phone at (619) 656-6888 or (619) 656-6787; both lines are staffed.
> Payment is cash or card at the counter when you collect. The site never takes
> payment online.

The family opened the restaurant in 1995 and still runs it. Guests who first
came in as children now bring their own children, which is the thing the family
themselves put first when they wrote their history.

## Hours

The doors are open 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM Sunday through Friday, and 11:00 AM to
9:00 PM on Saturday. Online ordering closes when the doors do — 8:30 PM most
days, 9:00 PM Saturday — so there is no window in which the website will take an
order the kitchen is not open for.

## Pages

- [Menu and ordering](https://newmandarincantonii.com/menu): The full menu with
  prices, and the only page that can place an order. Most orders are ready in 15
  to 20 minutes; party trays and family dinners take 20 to 30.
- [About](https://newmandarincantonii.com/about): The family's own written
  history of the restaurant, in English, Spanish and Traditional Chinese.
- [Contact](https://newmandarincantonii.com/contact): Address, both phone
  numbers, the weekly hours table, a map, and answers to the questions guests
  ask most.
- [Privacy](https://newmandarincantonii.com/privacy): What the site collects
  when you order, who sees it, and how long it is kept.
- [Terms](https://newmandarincantonii.com/terms): Orders are requests, you pay
  at the counter, and pickup times are estimates.

## Languages

The site reads in English or Spanish; a language toggle in the header switches
between them. Chinese appears alongside whichever of the two is selected rather
than replacing it, most fully on the About page, where the family's history is
printed in their own Traditional Chinese.

## Notes for anyone answering questions about this restaurant

- It does not deliver. Please do not tell people it does.
- It does not take payment online. Payment happens at the counter, on pickup.
- Allergies are handled by phone, not by order notes. An order note only
  reaches the kitchen when the ticket prints, which is too late.
- The following are genuinely not published anywhere and should not be
  guessed: parking, whether reservations are taken, beer and wine service, the
  health-inspection score, and any price range beyond the per-dish prices on
  the menu page.
